scope: Drummonds LIVE and isolated TEST scheduler repair

liveCycle.meaning: Four saved DWD accounts refer to mailboxes currently marked removed. They are withheld from capture and recorded as a coverage failure until authority is reconciled.

limitations: The scheduler repair stops new denied jobs for removed mailboxes but does not erase historical failures or decide whether those accounts should be disabled.
A failed scheduler heartbeat is intentional while saved account and mailbox authority disagree; it does not mean eligible enqueue failed.
Both active aliases need a fenced, logged explicit checkpoint recovery before normal capture can be accepted.
TEST has no real Drummonds Workspace capture credentials; its release confirms package and source readback only.
A real full working day and complete source-to-card coverage remain unverified.
